objective: Test whether target-owned spatial mask supervision helps unchanged primary support head on natural public occlusion. Not claim it solves target identity.

model.architecture: Existing V77 fused24x9x9 -> added Conv2d(24,2,1), weights/bias0. Aux output not read by primary scalar path.
model.scope: No new class/instance identity information; mixed target128/context42 unchanged. RGB branch RF phase differs from P3 nominal9; masks supervise nominal spatial anchors, not exact RGB centre labels.
model.initialization: Same V75 transfer and new primary0 initialization as V77; aux0; test lambda0 primary/shared-gradient equivalence on nonzero-generated inputs.

loss.primary: Unchanged mean BCE on same 96 primary queries
loss.A_eligibility: native_continuous AND NN_bounds AND cached9 intersection
loss.A_target: M0 within eligible; outsideM0 is Anegative only
loss.V_target: M4 within M0; outsideM0 has zero V loss
loss.reduction: For each query and channel: mean BCE separately for each present binary target class, then mean over present classes; noeligible query graphzero. Average all96 query losses includingzero.

data.GT9_rule: Original nominal9 literal / NN floor+.5 / native-cache intersection, full fingerprints/counts must match V79. No recenter, snap, filter or redefinition.
data.public_q: Existing GT-derived emulation using TRAIN synthetic initializer error bank; not actual public initializer.

training.sampler: Exact unchanged V77 pure sampler, 32natural+32after-nonanchor+32matched pair, source/class24
training.selector: Natural original VAL 4 source/class strata macroBCE only, every100 updates, strict lower best, first tie kept

outputs.primary: All80016 FP32 scalar logits + identical existing masks/IDs and metrics
outputs.auxiliary: All80016x2x9x9 FP16 logits. Source-only diagnostics pV=pA*ps,pC=pA*(1-ps),pO=1-pA; never primary posthocthreshold/selector.

admission_gate.failure_action: Preserve completed failed result; no current evaluation or loss/threshold/checkpoint sweep. Review auxiliary ownership maps and next explicit-target grounding candidate prospectively.
